task: Keep Black formatting operational when process-pool construction is unavailable

subtasks.description: Reproduce executor initialization failure in a constrained runtime
lessons: Inject the OS-facility failure at executor construction, before scheduling, to verify the real recovery boundary.

subtasks.description: Preserve formatting through a non-process executor
lessons: Optional parallelism should fail over narrowly on initialization errors while preserving the same scheduling contract.

constraints: The benchmark Python 3.8.3 runtime and historical optional test infrastructure were unavailable.
The fixed commit was inspected only after the candidate source patch was hashed.
No raw logs, prompts, or source patches are published.
lessons: Catch a narrow executor-construction OSError rather than masking errors raised by formatting tasks.
Use an executor compatible with the existing scheduling interface so recovery does not require a second code path.
A dependency installation failure can still permit focused source testing when the local module and required runtime dependencies import safely.
